sources.title: qwen3-4b-hermes-lora-peft-converted - FriendliAI
sources.snippet: This is an experimental PEFT-format conversion of the public MLX LoRA adapter edithatogo/qwen3-4b-hermes-lora. It is intended to make the Qwen3 v4 strict Hermes tool-call adapter usable from CUDA/Hugging Face tooling such as transformers, peft, and lm-evaluation-harness.
